name: Broodlord Lashlayer
source: [logs: Season of Discovery] Melee 3,096 to 4,652 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.74 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 21 kills on Season of Discovery (Normal, 2025-02-07 to 2026-09-24): the median of 89 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (3,878), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (84 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 2,522 weapon damage, spread 0.617, a 1.45 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 97 s (10th to 90th percentile 63 to 159). Weapon damage abilities: Mortal Strike 24573 16,110 to 26,548 from 9 hits; Knock Away 18670 3,423 to 5,471 from 8 hits; 15284 scaled with the melee (5 hits in the logs, too few). Abilities: Mortal Strike 24573 (500% weapon damage and 50% less healing taken for 5 s), Knock Away 18670 (weapon damage + 30), Cleave 15284 (weapon damage + 10), Blast Wave 23331 2,625 to 3,375 Fire, from the Classic Era client's spell data. Timers from the vmangos script, which says they are probably wrong.

notes: Knock Away's 50% threat cut isn't modelled. Blast Wave hits everyone near him, here the tanks only, and the healing sim adds the melee.

healing.notes: From Season of Discovery's logs (21 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 4 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,941 a second with overheal and absorbs (18% of the heals effective), 2.61 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 477 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (4% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warlock 7, Paladin 7, Warrior 4, Shaman 2, Druid 1.

raidHealing.notes: What Season of Discovery raids had on Broodlord Lashlayer (21 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 17 with 2 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 59 a second together, not in the events), 4 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (77% of the healing), each 1,570 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 1,721 a second (617 on the tanks, 1,084 on the rest, 84% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 73.1 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: Season of Discovery] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 21 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/sod_bwl_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 89% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.13 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Blast Wave 23331 from Broodlord Lashlayer (77% of the non-tanks' damage, in 21 of 21 kills): 3,000 to 3,000 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 94% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 72 to 100), 56.2 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 31.02 s at random (the logs count 1.4 casts a minute), the first at 33 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Melee 1 from Corrupted Red Whelp (6% of the non-tanks' damage, in 21 of 21 kills): 204 to 4,449 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 7% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 6 to 8), 4.3 landed a second on each (51% of it landing), so a cast every 15.68 s at random (the logs count 6.7 casts a minute), the first at 3 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Cleave 15754 from Broodlord Lashlayer (3% of the non-tanks' damage, in 18 of 21 kills): 3,174 to 5,108 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 7% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 6 to 14), 2.5 landed a second on each (53% of it landing), so a cast every 37.29 s at random (the logs count 1.3 casts a minute), the first at 31 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Tactical Charge 367418 from Broodlord Lashlayer (2% of the non-tanks' damage, in 17 of 21 kills): 2,315 to 2,665 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 6% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 6 to 8), 1.7 landed a second on each (63% of it landing), so a cast every 29.4 s at random (the logs count 0.9 casts a minute), the first at 43 s (median) of a 97 s kill. Together they land 73.1 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 73.1 in the logs.
